newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-SWEDEN-CZECH REPUBLIC DAVIS CUP SEMIFINAL DRAW.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SWEDEN-CZECH REPUBLIC DAVIS CUP SEMIFINAL DRAW.

text.p: Sweden's top ranked player Thomas Enqvist drew Czech number two Petr Korda in the first match of their Davis Cup World Group semifinal tie on Friday.
Czech number one Daniel Vacek will then face Swedish veteran Stefan Edberg in the second singles match on the first day of play on the fast Supreme surface at Prague's Sports Hall.
On Saturday, the Swedish pair of Niklas Kulti and Jonas Bjorkman are scheduled to face Jiri Novak and Bohdan Ulihrach in the doubles portion of the tie.
Vacek will then face Enqvist in the first reverse singles matchup on Sunday, while Korda will square off against his Australian Open championship doubles partner Edberg in the final match of the tie.
